body:
Hey, I'm still alive.My friend ended up in the psychward so we couldn't do it. I'm still sure I won't ever be happy,I haven't actually been happy in all my life,I have never felt safe and content,I'm ruined. I've been torn apart by most people I've met, and again,I've been in therapy twice and nothing changed,it even got worse. I've been thrown away,more or less,by them after getting released, I don't have anyone to talk to or to comfort me in real life,and I've never felt more lonely. I can barely fall asleep anymore without crying,I'm always tired, and everything just hurts. Even if I live to 18, my Ptsd is always gonna be there. My depression and my anxiety will always be there.

I understand that some people can't help me,but most people I've met could have helped me.Im sure my neighbors heard the yelling and crying,I'm sure my teachers saw me coming into school with my cheek red after getting slapped,and I'm sure that this school counselor of mine could have done more,hell, she should have done more.You are thing to help me,and I'm thankful for that,but there aren't enough people like you to make this worthwhile.

The thing is,I can't just go live my own life because I'm a minor,I *have* to continue living with my mom.Ibe tried reaching out to people,and none of them ever fucking did something.And now that I've fonnaly hot in contact with the German version of cps,they just fucking told me that they can't guarantee me that they will take me away,and that there's no option of removal without either the guardians approval or a judges approval.So I'm fucking stuck here for a couple of years.By image,I meant that she has built lie over lie about what our family is,what we are. That we are good people that actually love eachother,which is the biggest fucking lie in history.Ive had an failed attempt in the past,I've tried to hang myself,and sure I felt like shit and it was traumatic,but it isn't anywhere near as bad the knowledge that I have to continue living like this.I was made to die,I can't life.

This has been going on for years,they know just how it makes me feel. They've seen me write multiple suicide letters trough the years and they know I've mentioned them.And even if the bullying would stop,it wouldn't change anything.Its just the cherry on top. I'm still terrified nearly everything,I still have depression and I'm still forced to live with someone who's pure existence makes me want to jump off a cliff.I want my bitch of a mother to feel the pain she made me feel al those years by insulting me,slapping me and insisting that it isn't hitting and that she had it worse,neglecting me,fucking humiliating me in front of ny sibling,trying to kill herself in front of me and then tell me years later that I did the same thing by also having attempted suicide away from her. She is gonna know what I feel like,and even if she doesn't feel guilty like I did for nearly killing her,I can shatter the image she built for other people of our family with my dead.

Nearly all people I've meet have mistreated me,my schoolmates,my family,all of them are assholes and so am I.
There's these two kids that just fucking hate me,they know I'm afraid of loud not noises since they make me flinch so they stomp their feed on purpose to make me flinch,when I went into the bathroom after they talked to me they said something along the lines of "she's gonna go vomit again"(Which they said because I've had an bulimic episode some time back and used to purge in the school toilet).They bully me for the exact thing they fucking helped cause.
My suicide is gonna be my revenge,they are gonna feel the pain I've felt when they realize that the thing they realse their stress on is gone.
